prompts.title: 工业设计概念提示
prompts.description: 一个复杂的多步骤提示模板，用于在纯白色背景上生成一个高级工业设计概念，重点关注建筑几何、材料表面处理、品牌整合和人机交互元素。
prompts.content:
[BRAND NAME]: The core identity.

[CATEGORY]: Clothing / Food / Automotive / Lifestyle.

Goal: Generate a premium industrial design concept on a PURE WHITE background. 

1. INNOVATION & OBJECT

- Select one mundane functional object from [CATEGORY].

- Redesign it using unconventional, architectural, or origami-inspired geometry.

- The object must look like a high-end designer invention, not a standard product.

2. UNIFIED COMPOSITION

- Environment: A seamless, pure white studio background with a flat white floor.

- Interaction: A human hand (natural texture) is shown using the object in the foreground, demonstrating its unique ergonomics.

- Static Display: Right next to the hand, the same object is placed in a static, perfect pose to show its full silhouette and branding.

- Shadows: Soft, realistic grey drop shadows on the white floor to provide depth and ground the objects.

3. BRANDING & TEXT

- Identity: Apply the "{argument name="brand name" default="BRAND NAME"}" logo in a high-contrast dark color (Black or Navy) directly onto the object's surface.

- Technical Detail: Add small, elegant blocks of justified "specification text" in the white negative space around the objects for an editorial look.

- Pattern: Use a subtle, oversized abstract fragment of the brand's logo as a texture on the object's material.

4. MATERIALS & FINISH

- High-quality matte materials only: heavy-duty recycled paper, sandblasted metal, or soft-touch polymer.

- Sharp architectural lines and clean, premium craftsmanship.
prompts.translatedContent:
[BRAND NAME]：核心识别。

[CATEGORY]：服装 / 食品 / 汽车 / 生活方式。

目标：在纯白色背景上生成一个高端工业设计概念。

1. 创新与物体

- 从 [CATEGORY] 中选择一个普通的实用物品。

- 运用非传统、建筑风格或折纸启发式的几何形状对其进行重新设计。

- 该物品必须看起来像一个高端设计师的发明，而非标准产品。

2. 统一构图

- 环境：无缝、纯白色的工作室背景，配有平坦的白色地板。

- 互动：一只人手（自然纹理）在前景中展示如何使用该物品，以体现其独特的人体工程学设计。

- 静态展示：在手旁边，将同一物品以静态、完美的姿态放置，以展示其完整的轮廓和品牌标识。

- 阴影：白色地板上柔和、逼真的灰色投影，以提供深度并使物体有落地感。

3. 品牌与文字

- 标识：将“{argument name="brand name" default="BRAND NAME"}”标志以高对比度的深色（黑色或海军蓝）直接应用于物体表面。

- 技术细节：在物体周围的白色留白区域添加小巧、雅致的“规格说明文字”块，使其两端对齐，营造出编辑排版感。

- 图案：使用品牌标志的微妙、超大抽象碎片作为物体材料的纹理。

4. 材料与表面处理

- 仅限高品质哑光材料：重磅再生纸、喷砂金属或软触感聚合物。

- 锐利的建筑线条和干净、优质的工艺。

prompts.content: "Image from subject, medium shot, eye-level. Subject seated on a brick surface, legs crossed, facing forward. Hands raised in a defiant double middle-finger gesture. Wearing a white tailored suit jacket over a dark, unbuttoned collared shirt. Gold watch and ring accessories. Positioned on a sun-drenched brick driveway. Immediately behind is the rear profile of a bright {argument name="car color" default="yellow"} 1980s-era exotic sports car. Soft-focus tropical greenery in the deep background. Harsh, direct overhead sunlight creating high-contrast shadows. Saturated 1980s film palette with warm yellow tones and brilliant whites. High-key lighting with deep blacks. Coarse 50mm analog film grain, vintage lens bloom, and slight color fringing. Artistic interpretation, prioritize the camera angle, lighting scheme, and color grading over realistic skin tones."

prompts.description: 一个详细的提示，用于生成一张空灵、电影感的年轻女性肖像，她正在俏皮地眨眼。提示中指定了柔和、发光的皮肤纹理，休闲时尚的街头服饰（白色背心、橄榄色飞行夹克、牛仔裤），温暖的午后阳光营造出光晕效果，以及带有奶油般虚化的浅景深。
prompts.content:
Ethereal portrait of a charming young woman in her early twenties, captured in a relaxed candid moment, giving a gentle playful wink toward the camera with a dreamy, slightly mischievous expression. Her skin appears porcelain-smooth with a natural glow, lightly dusted with faint freckles across the bridge of her nose and cheeks. She has soft glossy lips with subtle natural makeup, delicate blush on her cheeks, and luminous skin tones that catch the warm afternoon sunlight.

prompts.description: 一个为 Nano Banana 2 设计的详细、超真实感提示，用于生成一张酷似安雅·泰勒-乔伊 (Anya Taylor-Joy) 的女性的私密、抓拍肖像。该提示细致地定义了场景、光线（柔和的室内日光）、拍摄对象的着装（格子套装配红色蝴蝶结）、姿势（坐在白色亚麻布上），以及诸如涂有亮红色指甲油的完美赤脚等具体细节。
